notes.title: New Release - Kings' Crusade: Arabian Nights
notes.notes:
Arabian Nights, downloadable content for The Kings' Crusade is now available on Steam!

Arabian Nights adds new units, two new heroes, and more into this real-time strategy game set during the Third Crusade.

In honor of this release, The Kings' Crusade and the New Allies DLC are 50% off until August 2nd at 10am Pacific Time!

notes.title: Now Available - The Kings' Crusade: New Allies
notes.notes:
New Allies, downloadable content for The Kings' Crusade is now available on Steam!

New Allies adds five new units, two new heroes, and more into this real-time strategy game set during the Third Crusade.

In honor of this release, The Kings' Crusade is 70% off until February 16th at 10am PST!

notes.title: The Kings' Crusade Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to The Kings' Crusade have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

The Kings' Crusade
  • Stability issues are solved
  • Balancing and difficulty updates
  • Faith related Relics optimized
  • Cavalry momentum under high game speed fixed
  • Behavior of shocked AI units upgraded
  • Crusader campaign, Bagdad mission restart bug fixed
  • Skill issues after unit upgrade fixed
  • Unit parameter info bug fixed
  • Bugs at active hero skills fixed

notes.title: Lionheart: Kings' Crusade Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Lionheart: Kings' Crusade have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Lionheart: Kings' Crusade
  • New units: Gascon Knights and Ayyubid Infantry become available during the campaigns
  • “Fill up ranks” after damaged unit upgrade fixed
  • damaged unit price after Armour or Weapon training cancellation fixed
  • Arms bearer unit skill fixed
  • Leader of Heavy infantry hero skill fixed
  • Shield of the Prince Ahmed relic fixed
  • the relic granting Cleave skill fixed
  • Quality Equipment upgrade fixed
  • Stronger Belief upgrade fixed
  • Jeanne d’Arc model fixed
  • crash issues at couple of sound files fixed
  • leaving the Campaign Map directs to the basic Main Menu
  • direction of the units in the deploy phase is modified
  • User Manual is available in the game folder \“Manual”

notes.title: Lionheart: Kings' Crusade
notes.notes:
Lionheart: Kings' Crusade is now available on Steam. As a special offer, if you purchase before October 18th you will receive the "New Allies" DLC when it releases in November for free!

The crowned heads of Europe launch a new military campaign to re-conquer the Holy Land. The time has come for you to assemble your armies and take back the land as Richard the Lionheart!
